description: Download subtitles and transcripts (YouTube and other platforms), video metadata, chapters, playlists, and search via MCP.
instructions: Smithery: paste your Google-Form-issued token into apiToken in session config; the gateway sends X-MCP-Api-Token to your edge (APISIX key-auth).

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.title: Get video transcript
tools.description: Fetch cleaned subtitles as plain text for a video (YouTube, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Vimeo, Facebook, Bilibili, VK, Dailymotion, Reddit). Uses auto-discovery for type/language when omitted. Optional: type, lang, response_limit (when omitted returns full transcript), next_cursor for pagination.

url.description: Video URL (supported: YouTube, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Vimeo, Facebook, Bilibili, VK, Dailymotion, Reddit) or YouTube video ID

format.description: Subtitle format (default from YT_DLP_SUB_FORMAT or srt)

type.description: Subtitle track type: official or auto-generated

lang.description: Language code (e.g. en, es). When omitted with Whisper fallback, language is auto-detected

response_limit.description: Max characters per response. When omitted, returns full content. When set: min 1000

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor from previous response for pagination

tools.name: get_raw_subtitles
tools.title: Get raw video subtitles
tools.description: Fetch raw SRT/VTT subtitles for a video (supported platforms). Optional: type, lang, response_limit (when omitted returns full content), next_cursor for pagination.

url.description: Video URL (supported: YouTube, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Vimeo, Facebook, Bilibili, VK, Dailymotion, Reddit) or YouTube video ID

format.description: Subtitle format (default from YT_DLP_SUB_FORMAT or srt)

type.description: Subtitle track type: official or auto-generated

lang.description: Language code (e.g. en, es). When omitted with Whisper fallback, language is auto-detected

response_limit.description: Max characters per response. When omitted, returns full content. When set: min 1000

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor from previous response for pagination

tools.name: get_available_subtitles
tools.title: Get available subtitle languages
tools.description: List available official and auto-generated subtitle languages.

url.description: Video URL (supported: YouTube, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Vimeo, Facebook, Bilibili, VK, Dailymotion, Reddit) or YouTube video ID

format.description: Subtitle format (default from YT_DLP_SUB_FORMAT or srt)

tools.name: get_video_info
tools.title: Get video info
tools.description: Fetch extended metadata for a video (title, channel, duration, tags, thumbnails, etc.).

url.description: Video URL (supported: YouTube, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Vimeo, Facebook, Bilibili, VK, Dailymotion, Reddit) or YouTube video ID

format.description: Subtitle format (default from YT_DLP_SUB_FORMAT or srt)

tools.name: get_video_chapters
tools.title: Get video chapters
tools.description: Fetch chapter markers (start/end time, title) for a video.

url.description: Video URL (supported: YouTube, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Vimeo, Facebook, Bilibili, VK, Dailymotion, Reddit) or YouTube video ID

format.description: Subtitle format (default from YT_DLP_SUB_FORMAT or srt)

tools.name: get_playlist_transcripts
tools.title: Get playlist transcripts
tools.description: Fetch cleaned subtitles (plain text) for multiple videos from a playlist. Use playlistItems (e.g. "1:5") to select specific items, maxItems to limit count.

url.description: Playlist URL (e.g. youtube.com/playlist?list=XXX) or watch URL with list= parameter

type.description: Subtitle track type: official or auto-generated (default: auto)

lang.description: Language code (e.g. en, ru). Default: en

format.description: Subtitle format (default from YT_DLP_SUB_FORMAT or srt)

playlistItems.description: yt-dlp -I spec: "1:5", "1,3,7", "-1" for last, "1:10:2" for every 2nd

maxItems.description: Max number of videos to fetch (yt-dlp --max-downloads)

tools.name: search_videos
tools.title: Search videos
tools.description: Search videos on YouTube via yt-dlp (ytsearch). Returns list of matching videos with metadata. Optional: limit, offset (pagination), uploadDateFilter (hour|today|week|month|year), dateBefore, date, matchFilter (e.g. "!is_live"), response_format (json|markdown).

uploadDateFilter.description: Filter by upload date (relative to now)

response_format.description: Format of the human-readable content: json (default) or markdown

prompts.name: get_transcript_for_video
prompts.title: Get transcript for video
prompts.description: Build a user message that asks the model to fetch the video transcript using the get_transcript tool.

arguments.name: url
arguments.description: Video URL or YouTube video ID

prompts.name: summarize_video
prompts.title: Summarize video
prompts.description: Build a user message that asks the model to fetch the transcript and summarize the video content.

arguments.name: url
arguments.description: Video URL or YouTube video ID

prompts.name: search_and_summarize
prompts.title: Search and summarize
prompts.description: Build a user message that asks the model to search YouTube for videos matching the query, then fetch the transcript for the first result and summarize it.

arguments.name: url
arguments.description: Optional: use this video URL instead of searching
